---
title: "Lightbox: retired quarto-ext/lightbox extension"
# bd-kcpkgftw. Port of Q1 tests/docs/extensions/basic/filter.qmd. Documents
# written for the quarto-ext/lightbox extension list it in `filters`. Q1
# drops that extension because the feature is built in (kBuiltInExtNames)
# and warns; the built-in does the work. Q2 warns Q-16-13.
filters:
  - lightbox
lightbox: auto
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: "Extension is now built in"
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'a.lightbox > img[src="images/mv-0.png"]'
        - - 'img.legacy-extension-ran'
---
